info.title: Conversational AI V3 API (staging, corrected)
info.description:
V3 operations deployed on staging on 10 Oct 2026. Based on the implementation spec at commit a6f5f25, with corrections from staging tests listed below. Not available yet: Campaigns, Start/Stop/Update Session and session actions. Do not send a request with an empty path ID. A trailing slash redirects to http:// and comes back as a 200 list.

Corrections:
- C1: Added the staging server URL. Source said: The source file has no `servers` entry. Staging: Every test on 10 Oct 2026 ran against https://studio-staging.rteappbuilder.com.
- C2: Declared the two required auth headers as a security scheme. Source said: The source file declares no authentication. Staging: A missing or wrong `X-Studio-V2-Gateway-Secret`, or a missing `X-Consumer-Username`, returned 401 `InvalidPermission`.
- C3: Added request bodies for Create Agent (both server schemas combined) and Update Agent (patch model, with the merge limitation stated), and the managed-provider `url` rule. Source said: The source file has no request body for either operation. Staging: Staging accepted the bodies used in the tests. A body without `pipeline.asr.url` for managed deepgram returned 400 `MissingRequiredField`. The `url` rule is server code and cannot be expressed in the schema.
- C4: Declared the response headers that staging sent: `Agora-Request-Id` on every response, `ETag` and `Location` where shown. Source said: The source file declares no response headers. Staging: Seen in the recorded responses. Staging sent no `RateLimit-*` headers, no ETag on the Secrets and Agents lists, and no Location on Set Key.
- C5: Added the specific error responses that staging returned, with their `reason` values. Source said: For Secrets, Agents and Sessions the source file declares only generic 4XX and 5XX. Staging: Each added entry was returned by staging on 10 Oct 2026 (see the test evidence).
- C6: Numbers: marked `sip_trunk.allowed_ips` as rejected and `$secrets` SIP passwords as not allowed. Noted that `inbound.call_policy.end_call` and `transfer` are rejected. Source said: The source file accepts all four in the request schema. Staging: `allowed_ips` and a `$secrets` password each returned 400 `NotImplemented`. `end_call` and `transfer` come from the server code only, so their schema is unchanged.
- C7: Create Number: described the 503 hidden pending record and the ignored Idempotency-Key. Source said: Not described. Staging: A 503 on 10 Oct 2026 left +12025550151 pending. Four retries also returned 503, and the record never appeared in List.

transfer.description: Rejected by the server with 400 `NotImplemented` (from the server code, not sent on staging). Reserved for runtime support; requests containing this field are rejected.

number.title: Number
number.description: International inputs normalize to E.164; national inputs normalize to national significant digits.

number.title: Number
number.description: May reformat the existing number but must not change its normalized identity.

password.title: Password
password.description: Plain password. `$secrets.<set>.<key>` references, also with leading whitespace, return 400 `NotImplemented` (seen on staging; the server trims the value before the check).

allowed_ips.description: Not supported. Any list returns 400 `NotImplemented` "Inbound IP restrictions are not supported." (seen on staging). An explicit null is also rejected ("allowed_ips cannot be null", src/schemas/numbers.py:17-20 and 41-43). Leave the field out.

api_key.description: Provider API key or a $secrets.<set>.<key> reference.

Contract_ModelCredential.description: Provider authentication. BYOK uses the customer-supplied API key; managed uses authentication provisioned by Agora.

url.description: Use only the fixed endpoint approved for the selected LLM vendor in managed or BYOK mode. Other endpoints are deferred until runtime SSRF and DNS-rebinding controls are available.

params.description: Set credential.mode to byok and provide credential.api_key to use customer-supplied authentication, or set it to managed to use authentication provisioned by Agora. Keep non-secret provider settings in params. This rule applies independently to ASR, LLM, TTS, avatar, and realtime MLLM modules.

max_history.description: Number of recent conversation messages retained for LLM context, 1-1024, matching V2. Agent instructions are unaffected.

failure_message.description: Message spoken through TTS when the LLM fails. No fallback message is implied when omitted.
